title: hq_content
description: Living HQ content results desk documents (Step 35): at_position (only what the timeline proves existed at that event) and latest (every artifact re-verified now). Read-only display data; publishable is always false. Step 36: reports carry separate artifact binding (matching/changed/legacy_unverified/unavailable), technical result and evidence freshness; posters from a 1.1 manifest are verified by hash. Step 37: read-only human review history with per-decision applicability (re-checked now in latest; only decisions provably saved by the position in replay).
